== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "[[Chad McCory]] of Carmel, Indiana is the youngest player to qualify for this year's Star Wars CCG World Finals" Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
